src: brief v2 §13a (bowling alley: fully playable lanes, the ball-return tunnel as a real squirrel route); BUILD_PLAN §3.16-§3.17, W3c #15. Placement chosen on the east commercial grass lots south of the boulevard behind the z = -135 u bay lines (studs: x 1274..1356, z -372..-521), clear of every lot, road, tree and harvested route (surveyed 2026-11-09); floorY sits 0.45 st above the highest ground under the footprint and the alley paving (floorY - 3.5) above the highest ground behind it. Units: STUDS (not HTML units). Route points are in the alley's local frame [X across the lanes, Y above the floor, D down the lane from the foul line]; tools/compile turns them into world points with Shared/Attractions/AlleyLayout.toWorld.

routes.name: bowling alley ball return (lanes 1-2)
routes.note: The ball return as one enclosed run (Shared/Routes/Enclosure): in at the bent grille in the alley wall (a ground mouth: walk in heading into it), under the back of house, the pit and the whole lane, up the ball lift inside the hood, and out with the head in the hood's mouth over the rack (a ledge mouth: Space or a click jumps out toward the bowler, Q drops onto the rack, S goes back); running back out of the grille steps onto the alley on its feet. A crawl under the pits. The ball rolls home along the same curve (Server/Attractions/AttractionService).
